verdict.rationale: Basecamp's official API repository says an OpenAPI spec exists that covers authentication, pagination, and every endpoint, so a machine-readable spec is published alongside the REST reference. The 404 probe was for a .md variant of the repo URL and says nothing about the spec itself. Missing for 10: an explicit download location or file/version details for the spec, and any independent or hands-on confirmation that it is complete and usable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: The OpenAPI spec and this REST API reference cover authentication, pagination, and every endpoint in detail.
